documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
INTIMATION FOR RESCHEDULING OF 60TH ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF THE COMPANY ON 26TH AUGUST 2026 (WEDNESDAY) AT 12:00 NOON (IST)

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, highlighting a highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT and record production across multiple value-added and distillate categories. The company maintained a comfortable leverage position with a gross debt-equity ratio of 0.18 and recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share alongside an earlier interim dividend. Management noted that term contracts for crude oil remain intact and operations continue efficiently despite logistical and geopolitical headwinds. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported its Q4 FY25 and full year financial and physical performance, highlighting high capacity utilization and upgraded enterprise status. Management noted that lower international product cracks impacted overall profitability and dividends compared to the previous year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the normal maintenance capital expenditure for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores.
guidance.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that in the southern market for Motor Spirit, production is less than demand with a clear shortfall of close to about 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that the southern market is mostly aligned to national growth projections, with Motor Spirit projected around 4%-5% and High-Speed Diesel at 3%.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as others are concerned, we have seen the southern market to be mostly aligned to the national growth projection. Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%. HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: The company stated that project execution for Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS has started in full swing.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: Management indicated that retail outlet endeavors will see significant commissioning in fiscal year 2026-27.
capex_expansion.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

capex_expansion.claim: The company reported capital expenditure of INR856 crores for the current year compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.
capex_expansion.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the Cauvery basin refinery project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reported that CPCL now has full custody of about 1,200 acres of land for the Cauvery project.
capex_expansion.quote: The most important updates with respect to the project is now we have full custody of the land. So, about 600 acres, which was already with CPCL and another 600 acres, which was acquired in the process, both is in our possession and the pre-project activities of boundary wall construction, and all those things are almost at a big stage.

capex_expansion.claim: The new refinery capacity is stated to be 9 million metric ton with a petrochemical intensity of 6% for polypropylene.
capex_expansion.quote: The new refinery capital cost is Rs 36,000 Crore approximately, 9 million metric ton capacity and petrochemical intensity of 6% and which is PP, polypropylene.

margins_costs.claim: The gross refining margin for quarter 4 was $13.75 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the core GRM for quarter 4 was $10.3 per barrel.
Foreign exchange losses were approximately INR200 crores for the quarter and around INR350 crores for the full year.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The Gross Refinery Margin for the full year 2024-25 was $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: For the fourth quarter, the Gross Refinery Margin stood at $6.22 per barrel compared to $7.7 per barrel in the corresponding previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel. Again, if I compare the previous year same quarter, it was $7.7 per barrel, but if I compare it to Singapore benchmark, which was only $3.1 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gain for the fourth quarter was $0.66 per barrel, amounting to Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: Operating Expenditure (Net) was reported as Rs 1,085 crore for 2022-23, Rs 1,215 crore for 2023-24, and Rs 945 crore for 9M 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 million metric tons, equivalent to 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput in quarter 4 reached 2.93 MMT, which is 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The new Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project will add a fresh capacity of 250 KTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of its installed capacity for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity and this must be seen with respect to the turnaround that has happened during the year

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput for Quarter 4 was 2.974 MMT, representing 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's gross debt-equity ratio stands at 0.18.
capital_allocation.quote: Our leverage position now stands at 0.18. Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Gross borrowings are INR1,900 crores and net borrowings are less than INR1,000 crores at INR973 crores, resulting in a net debt ratio of 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores. If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, for the first time, CPCL paid an interim dividend, and we are happy to announce that in addition to the interim dividend of INR8 per equity share of INR10 each, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share, which is 50% of the face value for the current year.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

capital_allocation.claim: Total capital expenditure spent during the current financial year was Rs. 673 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that logistical constraints and volatility of crude oil prices pose challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that uncertainties due to the volatility of crude prices pose a challenge.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: CST under recovery was reported as Rs 463 crore for 2022-23, Rs 361 crore for 2023-24, and Rs 246 crore for 9M 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects CCEA approval for the Cauvery basin refinery project in a few months.
management_commitments.quote: We are awaiting CCEA approval, that process is on, and we expect it in few months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
